info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Corporate Relation By Param1-spec
info.description: The Corporate Relations Management API enables businesses to update and manage corporate relations by specifying key parameters. This endpoint supports the PATCH method for making targeted updates to investor relations. Typical consumers include financial institutions, corporate development teams, and compliance officers seeking to maintain accurate corporate partnership information. Streamlining these interactions helps enhance collaboration and strategic alignment across organizations.

patch.description: This endpoint allows the modification of existing investor relations data for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. It facilitates updates to keep investor-related information accurate and current.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the investor relation details for the specified resource (RES-100045). It expects a JSON object containing the fields to be updated.
